resolve-conflicts.never: Force-pushes, pushes .github/workflows changes, or runs head code

address-feedback.never: Holds a write token, posts to the pull request, or touches a human thread: its fix leaves only as a patch

apply-feedback-patch.never: Runs a model or head code, force-pushes, or pushes under .github/workflows/

publish-feedback.never: Writes to the branch, or posts anything but the recorded replies

review-dependency.never: Holds a write token, posts to the pull request, merges or closes: its fix leaves only as a patch

apply-dependency-patch.never: Runs a model or head code, force-pushes, or pushes anything but a version change of manifest and lock files outside .github/

fix-docs.never: Holds a write token: it runs a script on head files, and its change leaves only as a patch

fix-ci.never: Holds a write token: it runs head code, and its change leaves only as a patch

apply-patch.never: Runs a model or head code, force-pushes, or pushes under .github/workflows/

resolve-issue.never: Holds a write token: it runs model-chosen commands, and its change leaves only as a patch

apply-issue-patch.never: Runs a model or code from the patch, moves an existing branch, or pushes under .github/workflows/

apply-dependency-verdict.never: Writes to the branch, merges, or closes a security update
